author: unknown
text_original: ता एव तिथयः शस्ता यास्वभ्यर्च्य जगत्पतिम् । तच्चित्तस्तन्मयो भूत्वा उपवासी नरो भवेत्
text_iast: tā eva tithayaḥ śastā yāsvabhyarcya jagatpatim / taccittastanmayo bhūtvā upavāsī naro bhavet
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; fasting is tied to worship of Jagatpati on appropriate tithis.

author: unknown
text_original: यः कारयेन्मन्दिरं केशवस्य पुण्यांल्लोकान् स जयेच्छाश्वतान् वै । दत्त्वारामान् पुष्पफलाभिपन्नान् भोगान् भुङ्क्ते कामातः श्लाघनीयान्
text_iast: yaḥ kārayenmandiraṃ keśavasya puṇyāṃllokān sa jayecchāśvatān vai / dattvārāmān puṣpaphalābhipannān bhogān bhuṅkte kāmātaḥ ślāghanīyān
notes: Primary verse explicitly says mandiraṃ keśavasya (a temple of Keśava). Secondary chapter witness exposes the same chapter/temple-building passage. This is a generic scriptural temple concept, not a modern-site identification.

author: unknown
text_original: ददौ दीपानि विधिवद् वासुदेवालये बले । सुगन्धितैलपूर्णानि घृतपूर्णानि च स्वयम्
text_iast: dadau dīpāni vidhivad vāsudevālaye bale / sugandhitailapūrṇāni ghṛtapūrṇāni ca svayam
notes: Primary verse explicitly locates lamp-giving in a Vāsudeva shrine (vāsudevālaye). Secondary witness covers the same chapter. Generic shrine evidence only.

author: unknown
text_original: दीपप्रदानं स्वयमायताक्षी विन्ध्यावली विष्णुगृहे चकार । गेयं स धर्म्यश्रवणं च धीमान् पौराणिकैर्विप्रवरैरकारयत्
text_iast: dīpapradānaṃ svayamāyatākṣī vindhyāvalī viṣṇugṛhe cakāra / geyaṃ sa dharmyaśravaṇaṃ ca dhīmān paurāṇikairvipravarairakārayat
notes: Primary verse explicitly says Vindhyāvalī offered lamps in Viṣṇu-gṛha and describes sacred recitation. Generic shrine evidence, not tied to a named modern temple.
